items.name: Yogurt, Fruit and Granola
method: Spoon the yoghurt into a bowl.
Top with granola and frozen berries. The berries thaw slightly as you eat.

items.name: Peanut Butter and Jam on Toast
method: Toast the bread.
Spread peanut butter on one slice, jam on the other. Or both on both.

items.name: Overnight Oats
method: Combine oats, greek yoghurt, chocolate powder and chia seeds in a jar or bowl.
Add enough milk or water to just cover, stir well.
Cover and refrigerate overnight.
In the morning, top with frozen berries and eat.

items.name: Chicken Caesar Wrap
method: Season chicken with salt, pepper and a squeeze of lemon. Pan-fry in olive oil for 4 minutes each side.
Rest 3 minutes, then slice.
Shred the lettuce, toss with dressing.
Warm the wrap briefly. Fill with lettuce, sliced chicken and shaved parmesan. Roll and serve.

items.name: Tuna Nicoise Salad
method: Boil the potatoes for 12 minutes. Add green beans for the last 4 minutes. Drain and cool.
Boil the egg for 7 minutes, cool in cold water, peel and halve.
Whisk olive oil, vinegar and mustard for the dressing.
Arrange potatoes, beans, halved tomatoes, olives and tuna on a plate.
Top with egg halves and drizzle with dressing.

items.name: Halloumi and Roast Veg Pitta
method: Slice pepper, courgette and red onion. Toss with olive oil and oregano.
Roast at 200C for 15 minutes.
Slice halloumi 1cm thick. Fry in a dry pan for 1-2 minutes each side until golden.
Warm the pitta, split open. Spread with hummus, stuff with veg and halloumi.

items.name: Egg Fried Rice
method: Beat the eggs. Heat half the oil in a wok, add eggs and scramble quickly. Remove.
Add the remaining oil, fry minced garlic and white parts of spring onion for 30 seconds.
Add rice, break it up. Stir-fry 2-3 minutes.
Add peas, soy sauce and sesame oil. Return the egg. Toss. Top with green spring onion.

items.name: Minestrone Soup
method: Finely chop onion, carrot and celery. Fry in olive oil for 8 minutes until soft.
Add crushed garlic, cook 1 minute. Add tomatoes and stock, simmer 15 minutes.
Add drained beans and pasta, cook until pasta is tender (about 8 minutes).
Stir in the spinach until wilted. Serve topped with grated parmesan.

items.name: Spaghetti Bolognese
method: Heat the olive oil in a pan. Finely chop the onion, carrot and celery, then fry gently for 8-10 minutes until soft.
Add the crushed garlic and cook for 1 minute. Turn up the heat and add the mince, breaking it up as it browns.
Stir in the tomato puree, then pour in the wine and let it bubble for 2 minutes.
Add the chopped tomatoes, crumbled stock cube and oregano. Simmer gently for 30-40 minutes.
Cook the spaghetti according to packet instructions. Drain and toss with the sauce. Serve with grated parmesan.

items.name: Thai Green Chicken Curry
method: Cook the jasmine rice as per packet instructions.
Heat the oil in a wok or pan. Add the curry paste and stir for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the diced chicken and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes.
Pour in the coconut milk, fish sauce and sugar. Simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the mangetout and baby corn, cook for 3 more minutes. Squeeze in lime juice and stir through the basil. Serve with rice.

items.name: Roast Chicken and Veg
method: Preheat oven to 200C/180C fan. Squeeze the lemon over the chicken thighs, tuck the lemon wedge and thyme underneath. Dot with butter and season.
Peel and quarter the potatoes. Parboil for 8 minutes, drain and shake to rough up the edges.
Toss potatoes, chopped carrot and parsnip with olive oil and crushed garlic in a roasting tray. Sit the chicken thighs on top.
Roast for 35 minutes until juices run clear and veg is golden.
Steam the broccoli for 4 minutes. Make gravy with the granules and 200ml boiling water plus any pan juices.

items.name: Beef and Black Bean Stir-fry
method: Slice the steak thinly against the grain. Toss with soy sauce and leave to marinate for 5 minutes.
Cook the noodles per packet instructions, drain.
Heat oil in a wok until smoking. Stir-fry the beef for 1-2 minutes until just browned, then remove.
Add sliced garlic, ginger, pepper and white parts of spring onion. Stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Return the beef, add black bean sauce and a splash of water. Toss with noodles. Top with green spring onion.

items.name: Greek Salad with Grilled Chicken
method: Marinate chicken in half the olive oil, lemon juice, half the oregano and salt for 10 minutes.
Grill the chicken for 5-6 minutes each side until cooked through. Rest, then slice.
Chop cucumber and tomatoes into chunks. Thinly slice the red onion.
Combine vegetables with olives in a bowl. Crumble over the feta.
Whisk remaining olive oil, vinegar and oregano. Pour over the salad. Top with chicken and serve with warm pitta.

items.name: Chickpea and Spinach Curry
method: Heat oil in a pan. Fry chopped onion for 6-8 minutes until soft.
Add minced garlic, ginger and spices. Cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add chopped tomatoes and simmer for 5 minutes.
Drain and add the chickpeas, pour in coconut milk. Simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in the spinach until wilted. Cook the rice per packet. Serve curry over rice topped with coriander.

items.name: Lamb Kebab Rolls
method: Preheat oven to 200C. Cut the potato into 1cm batons, toss with olive oil and the gunpowder spice mix. Roast for 30 minutes.
Thinly slice one shallot and put in cider vinegar to pickle while everything else cooks.
Mix the lamb mince with the kofta spice mix, black pepper and a pinch of salt. Shape into small sausages and roast for 12 minutes.
For the green chutney: blitz the mint, fresh coriander, olive oil, lemon juice and the second shallot in a small blender.
For the yoghurt sauce: mix greek yoghurt with grated cucumber, crushed garlic and a squeeze of lemon.
Chop the lettuce into strips and cube the tomato.
Char the tortillas on a dry hot pan.
Assemble: tortilla, green chutney, yoghurt sauce, kofta, potatoes, lettuce, tomato, pickled shallots. Roll up.
